movie.title: Citizen Vigilante
movie.overview: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.

reviews.author: TriceratopsAU
reviews.content: I only watched this movie after I heard that it was effectively "banned" by Germany. I am really glad I spent the time and money to see such a great film. It's an extremely effective and brutal reminder that we need to be aware of what our leaders and governments are importing to our shores. Dangerous people are being favoured over both our indigenous and European populations. We're tired of being ignored and it's time we start taking action.

reviews.author: aell88
reviews.content: Citizen Vigilante is easily one of Uwe Boll's strongest and most thought-provoking films. Powered by a solid performance from Armie Hammer, it follows an American expat who embarks on a violent crusade against criminals. Rather than offering easy answers, the film makes you question what happens when public faith in legal institutions completely collapses. The stylish visuals, dark humor, and willingness to tackle difficult themes keep it engaging, even if the graphic violence and political commentary won't be for everyone. Recommended for fans of 1970s vigilante cinema.

reviews.author: Kyo28
reviews.content: The fact that this movie was banned in various western countries means it touches a nerve with the people in power. When you get a lot of flack, it usually means you're over the target. And boy, is this movie over the target. It reminds me of the Charles Bronson Death Wish movies, but adds to it one of the most divisive yet important problem of the past decade(s) in western countries: uncontrolled migration and the rise of crime it brings with it. This movie in a sense feels good because it gives control back to the native Europeans who have been betrayed by their own politicians, murdered, raped and forced to be kept silent under the guise of compassion and descency. If you are atuned to the cultural problems tearing down Europe today and you have a revenge itch to scratch, this is the movie for you!

reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
Whilst by no means a great film, "Citizen Vigilante's" message could arguably be said to be overdue. In spite of Western globalist governments'authoritarian refusal to accept there is a problem with their open-door immigration policies and two-tier justice systems, there's also a growing refusal amongst native populations in Europe and elsewhere to accept the claim that their societies are naturally "diverse" and "monoculturalism" a lie. 

This film, which I glanced at, to be honest, is something of an action potboiler with plot holes aplenty. That said, it does still raise wholly valid points about disproportionate imported crime and the failure of justice systems to hold the perpetrators to account. I'm not surprised to hear it's been banned in Germany. I'll wager it will probably be banned elsewhere too. The UK is, I'm sure, a strong contender there, as is Australia. 

It does make me thankful I live in a country where this sort of crime is mostly but not entirely unheard of. Its also a warning of what can happen if we elect the wrong people to political office. 

In summary, whilst it's hardly a standout action flick "Citizen Vigilante" does possess a certain courage in making a no nonsense film that faces legitimate concerns with imported crime and cultural division head on.

reviews.author: Dean
reviews.content: Huge respect to Uwe Boll, because to make such a movie needs courage. Leftists hate this movie and they don't want you to watch it, because it reflects the harsh reality & the consequences of their disastrous policies they support & push. The emotional breakdown from critics over Citizen Vigilante proves exactly why this movie is a masterpiece of reality. Leftists and progressive reviewers hate this film because it completely shatters their sanitized, politically correct echo chamber and forces them to confront the uncomfortable truths they desperately try to ignore. Instead of feeding the audience mainstream propaganda, Uwe Boll delivers an uncompromising, raw look at the breakdown of law, order, and cultural cohesion in Europe. Armie Hammer’s intense performance perfectly captures the frustration of a no-nonsense, ex-military protagonist pushed to the edge by a broken system that coddles criminals. Leftist critics label this gritty realism as a "psyop" or "hate-manifesto" simply because they are terrified of a film that rejects tongue-in-cheek irony and aligns with traditionalist, right-wing realities. It doesn't rely on slick Hollywood budgets or elite approval; its unvarnished atmosphere reflects real-world headlines that traditional studios are too cowardly to touch. Ultimately, the furious reaction to the movie is the greatest proof of its success—it is an authentic, powerful piece of counterculture art that tells the truth and leaves the establishment completely rattled. For an independent filmmaker like Uwe Boll, getting that kind of furious reaction from the establishment is usually a badge of honor. It proves the movie didn't hold back and managed to completely disrupt their comfortable echo chamber. It's a clear sign the film struck a major nerve by completely rejecting their worldview.

reviews.author: GrodanHej
reviews.content:
There are glimpses here of what could have been a good vigilante movie with some interesting social commentary about Europe’s inability to deal with crime linked to migration. Instead, the film spends too much time on other things. Uwe Boll doesn’t seem to have any clear message or ideology. He mostly just seems to want to tap into Europeans’ (not entirely unjustified) frustration and anger.

The idea of a regular ”citizen vigilante” taking matters into his own hands to save his country (the film never even makes it clear which European country it’s supposed to be) also falls flat when the main character turns out to be an American real estate millionaire who, ironically, seems to be living in the country illegally himself. Vigilante movies usually work best when the main character has a personal reason for doing what they do, like Charles Bronson’s character in the Death Wish movies. Here, the protagonist seems more driven by some sort of savior complex, which makes him hard to relate to or care much about.

I wasn’t expecting much from this movie, but I was still disappointed by how it wasted what could have been a really good premise. How much you enjoy this movie will partly depend on your political views. Some people will see it as xenophobic, islamophobic, and glorifying violence and vigilantism. Others will find it refreshingly outspoken. Either way, though, it has some pretty major flaws in both its story and execution.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a frustrated citizen begins hunting down dangerous criminals, his violent crusade turns him into a viral social media phenomenon and sets him on a collision course with the local police chief.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Disillusioned by a failing justice system, a man decides to enforce the law himself by targeting dangerous criminals across the city. As he documents his violent vigilante acts online, he quickly becomes a controversial social media sensation worshipped by the public. However, his unyielding campaign forces the local police chief to relentlessly hunt him down before the city erupts into complete lawlessness. Caught between public admiration and the strict confines of the law, the vigilante must decide how far he is willing to go for his brand of justice.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In a city plagued by rising crime and systemic corruption, an ordinary man named Mark grows weary of watching dangerous felons walk free on legal technicalities. Driven by personal loss, he arms himself and begins systematically tracking down the city's most dangerous criminals, delivering lethal justice where the courts have failed. Mark records his clandestine operations, posting them online to expose the city's rot, which unexpectedly transforms him into an overnight social media star dubbed the 'Citizen Vigilante.' While a frustrated populace rallies behind his ruthless crusade, Police Chief Elizabeth Vance views Mark as a dangerous menace who threatens the fundamental order of society. Chief Vance launches a high-stakes task force dedicated to unmasking and apprehending the vigilante before vigilante justice completely replaces the rule of law. As Mark's online popularity surges, copycat vigilantes begin emerging, leading to chaotic violence that spirals wildly out of control. Torn between his original moral crusade and the dangerous viral entity he has created, Mark finds his safehouses compromised and his allies targeted. Chief Vance closes in on Mark's identity, forcing a tense, face-to-face confrontation that tests both their beliefs about justice, morality, and law. Ultimately, Mark is forced to make a catastrophic choice between maintaining his anonymous revolution or facing the tragic consequences of taking the law into his own hands.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Citizen Vigilante is a gritty, modern action thriller that explores the dark intersection of law enforcement, vigilantism, and social media culture. The story follows a fed-up citizen who decides to bypass the legal system and hunt down violent criminals, broadcasting his exploits online to a public desperate for retribution. As his digital footprint grows, he transforms into a polarizing folk hero, igniting a fierce moral debate across the nation. Standing in his way is the city's principled police chief, who must race against time to bring the vigilante to justice before his viral popularity destabilizes the entire city. Packed with intense action, sharp drama, and thought-provoking social commentary, the film delves into the dangerous appeal of vengeance in an era driven by viral fame.
